scripts.docker:build: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:build-identity: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml stop identity-service && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml rm -f identity-service && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build identity-service
scripts.docker:build-product: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml stop product-service && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml rm -f product-service && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build product-service
